candidate.source_a: Calcium phosphate forms crystalline deposits in bone tissue through osteoblast-mediated mineralization.
candidate.source_b: Marine diatoms precipitate silica-based cell walls using enzymatic silicatein proteins.

counterfactuals: If Source A didn't mention osteoblast-mediated mineralization, it wouldn't support the candidate.
If Source B didn't mention silicatein proteins, it wouldn't support the candidate.

evidence_assessment.notes: Source A shows osteoblast-mediated mineralization (protein-catalyzed biogenic process). Source B shows silicatein proteins precipitating silica (protein-catalyzed biogenic precipitation). Both independently support the candidate.
